pages.title: Loot Feeds the Factory
pages.text: Exploring and building aren't separate games here. Loot from dungeons and other dimensions often goes straight into Create machines.

**Boss gear:** Cataclysm x Create rebuilds Cataclysm's weapons and armor as Create assembly lines, and lets a crushing wheel recycle old gear.

[#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm x Create](entry://exploration/cataclysm_create)[#]().

**Magic:** Iron's Spells inks and elixirs can be filled and emptied with Create's spouts and drains. Create: Wizardry builds on Iron's Spells.

[#](2E5AAC)[Magic](entry://exploration/magic)[#]().

**Strange fluids:** Create: Dragons Plus adds fan processing with dragon's breath, powder snow and more, and Enchantment Industry turns experience into a fluid you can pipe.

[#](2E5AAC)[Encased Fans](entry://create_basics/fans)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Enchanting](entry://industry/enchanting)[#]().

**Other worlds' materials:** Northstar's planets give titanium and tungsten, and Twilight Forest's fiery blocks heat a boiler.

[#](2E5AAC)[Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#]().
